title: Metadata Diagnostics reports "`picklist` and `options` cannot both be declared" on fields that declare only `picklist`: the runtime resolves the picklist into `options` and then validates its own output
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 6 Studio (report comment 6443071470 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D1; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ozavxm` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/6-studio/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

Studio › HotCRM › any object › *Read-only · Customize with an overlay* (lands on Setup › All Metadata Types): the Object tile carries a red issue badge; **View all issues** reads "Metadata Diagnostics — 8 issue(s) across 524 items", 10 messages "`picklist` and `options` cannot both be declared" on `crm_account.industry`, `crm_contact.salutation` / `lead_source`, `crm_contract.payment_terms`, `crm_event.related_to_type`, `crm_lead.salutation` / `industry` / `lead_source`, `crm_opportunity.lead_source`, `crm_task.related_to_type`, `crm_quote.payment_terms` (`f-metadata-issues.png`, `e-obj-account-overlay-click.png`).

The source declares `picklist` only (e.g. objectstack-ai/hotcrm `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts`, `industry`: `picklist: 'industry'`, no `options`), exactly what the diagnostic's own advice says ("Keep `picklist: '<name>'` and delete `options`"), and the built `dist/objectstack.json` carries `picklist` only. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_account` serves both `picklist: "industry"` and the resolved `options`: the runtime resolves the picklist and then flags the result.

**Who loses:** every app that uses shared picklists shows false red errors to its admins, and the page says "Errors block features that depend on the item", so an admin is told the app is broken when it is not (the select fields work).

## Expected

The diagnostic judges the authored shape (or skips `options` it derived itself); a field that names only a picklist is clean.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "metadata diagnostics picklist and options cannot both be declared false positive": 2 hits — #10424 and #7656 (closed, other diagnostics). None reports this.

**Reader who acts:** the metadata load-time diagnostics owner (`@objectstack/metadata`).
